simple.meaning: אֲחֻזָּה (ʼăchuzzâh) appears 66 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 5 more, beginning at Genesis 17:8. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֲחֻזָּה (H272) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows אֲחֻזָּה through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.full: H272. achuzzah אֲחֻזָּה 66 noun feminine possession — ׳א Gen 47:11 11 t.; construct אֲחֻזַּת 17:8 21 t.; suffix אֲחֻזָּתְךָ Psa 2:8 ; — possession , P & late; of landed property Gen 47:11 ; Lev 14:34 ; 25:10 , 13 , 25 , 27 , 28 , 33 (houses); 25:41 ; 25:45 ; Leviticus 21:46; Num 27:4 ; 32:5 , 22 , 29 ; 35:8 ; Deut 32:49 ; Josh 21:12 , 39 ; Ezek 44:28 ; 45:5-6 , 7 (twice in verse); 45:8 ; 46:18 (3 t. in verse); 48:20-21 , 22 (twice in verse); 1Chr 7:28 ; 9:2 ; 2Chr 11:14 ; 31:1 ; Neh 11:3 ; with ׳א אֲחֻזָּה אֶרֶץ, = land possessed, one's own land Gen 36:43 ; Lev 14:34 ; 25:24 ; Num 35:28 ; Josh 22:4 , 9 , 19 (twice in verse), compare הָאָרֶץ אֲחֻזַּת Lev 27:24 ; with ׳שׂ אֲחֻזָּה שָׂדֶה, 27:16 , 22 , 28 , compare 27:21 ; with ׳ע אֲתֻּזָּה עִיר, 25:32-33 , נַחֲלָה אֲחֻזַּת = possession by right of inheritance Num 27:7 ; 32:32 , & א ׳נַחֲלַת 35:2 compare ׳א בְּנַחֲלָה Ezek 46:16 (but Co as Num 27:7 so B); קֶבֶר אֲחֻזַּת Gen 23:4 , 9 , 20 ; 49:30 ; 50:13 ; ׳א עוֺלם 17:8 ; 48:4 ; Lev 25:34 ; in promise to Davidic king אַסְפֵיאָֿרֶץ וַאֲחֻזָּתְךָ Psa 2:8 (|| נַחֲלָה ); figurative of ׳י as portion of Levitical priests Ezek 44:28 (|| נַחֲלָה ).
